test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Satiate
solution:
The correct answer is '**Satisfy**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** synonym for the given word '**Satiate**' is '**Satisfy**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**Stiate**' is '**satisfied to the full; sated**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**Satisfy**' is '**meet the expectations, needs, or desires of (someone)'**.
 
• Hence, the **appropriate **answer is '**Satisfy**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **State**- the particular condition that someone or something is in at a specific time.
 
• **Saturate**- cause (something) to become thoroughly soaked with water or other liquid so that no more can be absorbed.
 
• **Starve**- suffer or die or cause to suffer or die from hunger.
